opportunities.title: Drive App Installs for Car Deals
opportunities.description: I need a steady stream of genuine Indian car shoppers—specifically people already planning to buy a new car—to install our dealership app. The app showcases brand-new models, lets users book a free home test drive, and unlocks limited-time Diwali discounts. Any outreach channel you control is welcome: Facebook or Instagram pages, automotive Telegram groups, WhatsApp communities, YouTube reviews, influencer shout-outs—whatever reliably reaches buyers in the major Indian metros. All I care about is that every click and install shows up as real traffic in our dashboard; bots or incentivised installs will void the test. Pilot arrangement • We begin with a small paid test so both of us can verify quality. • Payment is tied directly to the installs (or at minimum the verified clicks) I see on my end. • Once performance is proven, we can ramp budgets and discuss ongoing milestones. Deliverables for the pilot • Unique tracking link usage so I can attribute traffic. • Daily summary of channels used, clicks generated, and installs logged. • Quick response over WhatsApp to fine-tune creatives or copy as needed. Drop your WhatsApp number in the chat and I’ll share the link, creatives, and target cities list. If your audience truly matches active car buyers in India’s major cities and you can move installs, we can start right away.

opportunities.title: Soft Storybook Rose Garden Animation
opportunities.description: I’m commissioning a short animated video that opens on a lush garden overflowing with roses, where a small group of children wander between the blooms and sing together. The entire piece should feel like it has been lifted from the pages of a gentle, hand-painted storybook: soft edges, warm pastels, and subtle textures that look as though they were brushed onto watercolor paper. Scope • Length: roughly one minute (flexible enough to hit the natural end of the song). • Style: strictly the ​“Soft storybook animation”​ option I selected. No glossy 3D or flat Saturday-morning looks—think calm, dreamy, and timeless. • Audio: I’ll provide the children’s vocal track; you’ll sync it convincingly so lip movements and rhythm match. Light ambient garden sounds are welcome if you’d like to add depth. • Deliverables: storyboard, rough animatic for approval, final 1080p (or higher) video, plus all layered source files. Please attach a detailed project proposal outlining your creative approach, milestones, and turnaround. If you have previous works that prove you can nail this painterly aesthetic, feel free to link them inside the proposal, but the focus should remain on how you plan to execute this specific piece from first sketch to final render.

opportunities.title: Drone, Robotics & 3D Workshops
opportunities.description: I’m rolling out a STEM initiative across several schools and colleges and need an experienced trainer who can run engaging, hands-on workshops in three areas: drone piloting and build, introductory robotics, and practical 3D printing. Audience & style • Sessions must be adaptable for school students, college students, and our teaching staff. • The emphasis is on doing—learners should spend most of their time assembling, coding, printing, flying, and troubleshooting rather than watching slides. Scope of work You will design and deliver a series of modular workshops that blend basic demonstrations with guided, build-and-fly (or build-and-print) projects. Typical topics might include: – Drone safety, frame assembly, flight controller setup, and first-flight practice – Robotics fundamentals using Arduino or Raspberry Pi, sensor integration, and simple autonomous tasks – 3D modelling in Tinkercad/Fusion 360, slicing, printer calibration, and post-processing Deliverables 1. A clear session plan for each module, timed for 60- to 90-minute blocks 2. Materials list and pre-session setup guide 3. Slide deck or handouts for basic theory sections 4. Step-by-step build instructions with photos or short clips 5. Quick-check assessments or mini challenges to confirm learning 6. Post-workshop report summarising progress and next-step recommendations Acceptance criteria • Every participant completes at least one fully functional drone/robot or prints a usable 3D object. • All lesson materials are turnkey so future staff can rerun sessions without outside help. • Safety checklists and risk assessments are included. If you’re comfortable juggling soldering irons, slicer software, and curious minds of all ages, I’d love to hear how you’d structure the first round of workshops and the timeline you’d need to get started.

opportunities.title: First-Year Architecture Portfolio Tutoring -- 2
opportunities.description: I am in my first year of architecture and must complete six portfolio briefs by December. I am looking for a tutor who can work alongside me on every stage of each brief—from the first spark of an idea right through to polished presentation boards. What I need most is practical, hands-on help creating the work itself. That includes helping me brainstorming concepts, translating them into drawings and diagrams, refining digital and physical models, and making sure the final layouts read clearly. I will be expected to mix hand sketches and physical model-making with digital tools such as AutoCAD, Rhino, SketchUp, Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, so a solid command of these platforms is essential. We will meet regularly (online or in person, whichever is feasible) to: • Develop and test design ideas for each brief • Produce and iterate drawings, diagrams, and 3D models • Prepare final presentation boards that meet first-year architectural standards By December I aim to submit six cohesive, well-thought-out briefs that demonstrate creative thinking, technical accuracy, and strong visual communication. If you can guide me through that journey—offering constructive critique, workflow tips, and clear explanations—I’d love to work with you.

opportunities.title: 360° Detailed Grand Piano Renderings
opportunities.description: I need a 3D artist who can build a highly detailed grand piano model—keys, pedals, strings, internal mechanics, the whole works—and then generate a complete 360-degree set of still images. The purpose is product presentation for an online listing, so each angle has to look polished, with realistic reflections and materials that match an ebony showroom finish. I will supply reference photos and any dimensions you need. Please use a professional toolset (Blender, 3ds Max, Maya, or similar) so the raw project file remains editable for future tweaks. Deliverables • Fully textured, photo-realistic 3D model of the piano in a common format (FBX or OBJ) • High-resolution renders covering the full 360°—enough frames to showcase front, back, sides, top, and detailed close-ups of the action and pedals • Any lighting or scene files required to reproduce the renders Accuracy of proportion and clean geometry are critical; hinges, lid prop, and pedal mechanism should all stand up to close inspection. If this sounds straightforward for you, let’s talk timeline and get started.

opportunities.title: Editor Dinámico de Videos Cortos
opportunities.description: Buscamos editor/a de vídeo para Reels y TikTok · Remoto · Media jornada Somos una agencia de marketing en España que produce contenido constante para Instagram y TikTok, y buscamos un/a editor/a especializado/a en vídeo corto con estilo dinámico para unirse a nuestro equipo de forma estable. Qué harás Recibirás el material grabado junto con el guion o las indicaciones de cada pieza. Montarás vídeos ágiles: cortes rápidos, motion graphics ligeros, zooms, transiciones fluidas y subtítulos que mantengan la atención hasta el último segundo. Adaptarás cada vídeo al formato vertical, cuidando resolución, color y ritmo musical. Entregarás los archivos finales listos para publicar (MP4/H.264) y, cuando haga falta, el proyecto editable en Premiere, Final Cut o DaVinci Resolve. Cómo trabajaremos 100% remoto, con dedicación de media jornada. Volumen regular de vídeos cada semana, con objetivos claros (duración, gancho inicial, retención). Pago mensual fijo en dólares. Revisiones periódicas para cuidar la calidad y los plazos. Lo que valoramos Experiencia editando Reels o TikToks con buenos resultados. Dominio de subtítulos, efectos de texto y sound design. Rapidez de respuesta y comunicación proactiva. Iniciativa para proponer mejoras cuando veas oportunidades. ¿Te interesa? Envíanos tu portafolio de vídeos cortos e indícanos cuántas piezas de este estilo podrías entregar por semana. Los perfiles seleccionados harán una pequeña prueba pagada ✨

opportunities.title: Energetic Devotional Reel Edit
opportunities.description: I’m putting together a fast-paced, energetic and uplifting devotional reel to promote an upcoming temple bhajan/event. You’ll receive a folder packed with my raw video clips, photos, and an audio track; what I need back is a striking, seamlessly edited reel that keeps viewers engaged from the first frame to the last. Sequence the best moments, work the photos in rhythm with the music, and overlay clear details about the temple and event so the message is impossible to miss. Please add tasteful motion graphics, smooth transitions, and a vibrant color grade that preserves a devotional feel while still feeling modern and lively. Sync everything tightly to the beat, polish the audio if needed, and make sure the pacing never drags. Deliverables: • Final vertical reel (1080×1920, MP4) ready for Instagram, Facebook Reels, and WhatsApp • One revision round for fine-tuning timing, text, or colors • Project source file (Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve) If you’re comfortable weaving photos, clips, and sacred music into a captivating short-form video, I’d love to see your work and get started right away.

opportunities.title: Desarrollo de Guía Práctica para el Aprendizaje de Niños con Autismo
opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional para desarrollar una guía completa y práctica dirigida a niños con problemas de autismo. El objetivo principal es proporcionar herramientas y estrategias que faciliten su trabajo diario y mejoren significativamente sus condiciones de aprendizaje. La guía debe ser fácil de entender, incluir ejemplos claros y actividades que puedan ser implementadas por padres y educadores. Se valorará la inclusión de enfoques pedagógicos adaptados y recursos visuales que apoyen la comprensión y el desarrollo de habilidades en esta población. El contenido debe ser estructurado, didáctico y enfocado en resultados tangibles para el progreso de los niños. Categoría: Redacción y Traducción Subcategoría: Redacción de artículos ¿Cuántas palabras?: Más de 5000 palabras

opportunities.title: Transcripción español con identificación hablantes
opportunities.description: Tengo un audio de 4 minutos en español en el que intervienen varias personas. Necesito una transcripción limpia que incluya únicamente lo que se dice, indicando con claridad qué parte corresponde a cada hablante (por ejemplo: “Hablante 1: …”, “Hablante 2: …”). Si consideras que mejorar la calidad del audio o separar ligeramente las pistas facilita distinguir las voces, eres libre de aplicar tus propias técnicas de edición o noise reduction antes de transcribir. Entregables esperados: • Archivo de texto editable (Word o Google Docs) con la transcripción completa. Audio Mejorado con voces identificadas • Etiquetado coherente de cada participante a lo largo de todo el documento. Precisión y coherencia serán los criterios principales para aprobar el trabajo.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40800683, publicado hace 4 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 10 - 30.

opportunities.title: Setup Gmail Bisnis Marketing
opportunities.description: Saya membutuhkan bantuan untuk menyiapkan Gmail bisnis berbasis Google Workspace yang siap menunjang pemasaran dan penjualan. Tujuan utamanya adalah mengirim email promosi ke calon pelanggan dengan cara yang terukur, profesional, dan sesuai regulasi. Pekerjaan yang saya harapkan meliputi: • Konfigurasi akun Google Workspace lengkap dengan domain saya, termasuk verifikasi SPF, DKIM, dan DMARC agar reputasi pengiriman optimal. • Penataan kotak masuk: label, filter, dan signature profesional. • Pembuatan dua template email promosi responsif serta panduan pengiriman massal menggunakan add-on seperti Mailmeteor, GMass, atau serupa. • Rancang alur kampanye: segmentasi dasar, pelacakan open-rate, dan pelaporan sederhana. • Panduan membangun daftar email berizin—mulai dari pembuatan formulir opt-in, lead magnet, hingga integrasi landing page atau CRM. • Edukasi best practice anti-spam, batas pengiriman Gmail, dan ritme follow-up yang efektif. • Dokumen atau rekaman singkat sebagai panduan supaya saya dapat menjalankan kampanye selanjutnya secara mandiri. Hasil dianggap selesai ketika: – Email uji coba masuk ke inbox utama tanpa label spam. – Domain terverifikasi dengan reputasi baik. – Template promosi siap digunakan. – Saya memahami langkah-langkah membangun dan memelihara daftar email berizin. Pengalaman sebelumnya dengan Google Workspace dan email marketing automation sangat dihargai. Sertakan estimasi waktu pengerjaan serta contoh pekerjaan serupa yang pernah Anda tangani.

The flow is straightforward: the bot receives a message, searches the question-and-answer list I’ll supply (JSON, CSV or any format you prefer), then returns the matching answer. Configuration file or admin command that lets me update the Q&A list easily without touching the core code. 3. Brief README covering setup, environment variables, and how to extend the FAQ list. 4. A short demo video or screenshots proving the bot answers from my sample file. I’ll provide the first batch of questions and answers as soon as we start, and I can test the bot live in my own Telegram group. Let me know the stack you prefer and the estimated timeframe to deliver an MVP.

opportunities.title: After Effects Masking & Tracking
opportunities.description: I’m gearing up to finish a batch of roughly 100 short videos and I need an experienced After Effects artist to jump in and keep the post-production pipeline moving smoothly. The bulk of the work involves two recurring tasks: • Clean, accurate masking and camera tracking on moving handheld footage that usually has moderate walking or panning motion. • Environment replacement—mostly swapping in realistic indoor or outdoor backgrounds so the final shots look seamless. You can tackle the job full-time on an hourly basis or quote me a fixed rate per finished video; I’m flexible as long as we maintain consistent turnaround and quality. Typical workflow: – Receive the raw clip (ProRes or H.264) plus reference boards. – Track the camera (AE 3D Camera Tracker or Mocha, whichever you prefer). – Create tight masks around subjects, refine edges, and lock them to the track. – Composite the new background plate, balance color and light so it sits naturally, and deliver both the final render (ProRes 422) and the organized .aep with all assets linked. I’ll supply all background plates, LUTs, and a style guide. You just need solid mastery of After Effects, masking, Mocha/AE tracking, and an eye for photo-real compositing. If this sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s talk schedule and start knocking these videos out.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40800669, publicado hace 4 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 250 - 750.

opportunities.title: Translate & Rebrand AutoCAD Drawings
opportunities.description: I have a full set of manufacturing drawings created in AutoCAD. All notes and call-outs are currently in Chinese. I need each sheet fully translated into clear, UK-standard English while keeping every dimension and tolerance exactly where it is. At the same time, the drawings must look as though they originated from our organisation, not the original supplier. Here is the scope in plain terms: • Replace all Chinese text with English that aligns with UK manufacturing standards and our internal wording conventions. • Swap every instance of the original company name, logo, and title block with our own, and update the drawing numbers to our numbering scheme. • Keep geometry, dimensions, and tolerances intact; only the language and branding change. Final deliverables I expect are clean, native AutoCAD (.dwg) files for each drawing plus matching PDFs ready for issue. All layers, line types, and styles should remain organised and editable. If anything in the source file is unclear, ask before proceeding so we avoid rework. If you have handled bilingual or rebranded technical drawings before and are comfortable with UK drafting conventions, this should be a straightforward project.

opportunities.title: Cute 3D Mascot Animation
opportunities.description: About the Project We're looking for a talented **3D Character Designer and Animator** to help bring our mascot to life. We already have a character concept and several AI-generated visual references illustrating its appearance, personality and different expressions. Your job will be to transform these references into a **unique, professionally designed, consistent and production-ready mascot** that can be used throughout our mobile application, website and marketing campaigns. We want the character to feel friendly, confident, slightly playful and instantly recognisable, with a premium, soft 3D appearance similar to modern consumer app mascots. This is not simply an illustration project. We're looking to build a character that becomes a core part of our brand identity. ## What We're Looking For **1. Character Design & Development** - Refine our existing mascot concept into an original, distinctive character. - Create a consistent 3D or premium 2.5D visual style. - Maintain consistent proportions, facial features, colours and personality across all poses. - Develop a reusable character system that allows us to create additional expressions and animations in the future. - Ensure the character works at both large and small sizes, including inside a circular avatar in our app's chat interface. **2. Different Expressions & Character States** We want the mascot to react naturally to different activities and situations inside our app. Initial states include: - **Idle / Waiting:** Relaxed, smiling and ready to help. - **Listening:** Attentively listening when the user asks something. - **Thinking:** Curious or thoughtful expression. - **Searching:** Quickly typing on a laptop, wearing headphones, searching for information. - **Processing:** Focused on completing a task. - **Found It:** Happy expression, giving a thumbs-up. - **Success / Completed:** Celebrating a successful action. - **Nothing Found:** Slightly disappointed or apologetic expression. - **Need More Information:** Curious expression, asking the user for clarification. - **Urgent Attention:** Alert and attentive without appearing alarming. We will also require additional static character illustrations for features such as account security and empty screens. **3. Lightweight Character Animations** The mascot will appear primarily inside a **small circular avatar at the top of our app interface**. We want subtle but engaging animations triggered by user interactions. For example: - When a user submits a question, the character begins typing rapidly on its laptop. - While searching, it looks focused and occasionally reacts. - When a result is found, it smiles and gives a thumbs-up. - If nothing is found, its expression changes sympathetically. - When idle, it has a subtle breathing, blinking or movement animation. The animations should be smooth, lightweight, loopable where appropriate and optimised for use in a mobile application. **4. opportunities.title: Delphi WhatsApp API Message Sender
opportunities.description: I want a small Delphi application that talks directly to the official WhatsApp Business API so I can send on-the-fly text messages to customers who already have an active chat with my number. No browser automation, no desktop-app tricks—pure API calls. How it should work • I paste or load the list of customer phone numbers (all are existing contacts). • I type a free-form message in a memo field. • When I hit Send, the program calls the /messages endpoint, passes the numbers one by one (or in a batch if that is allowed), and returns the WhatsApp message IDs so I can see delivery and read status. • Any API errors (rate limits, bad tokens, etc.) must be caught and shown in a log panel and written to a lightweight SQLite file for auditing. Technical preferences • Delphi 11 or higher, using native REST components or a lightweight HTTP library. • JSON handling via System.JSON or SuperObject—whatever is cleanest. • Bearer token and phone-number-ID should be loaded from an .ini file so I can update credentials without recompiling. Deliverables 1. Compiled Windows 64-bit executable. 2. Full, well-commented Delphi source code. 3. README explaining how to obtain the WhatsApp Business access token, where to place it, and how to run the program. 4. Quick test demonstrating a successful send and retrieval of delivery status. Acceptance criteria The build is considered complete when I can: • Enter a text string, choose at least one existing customer number, click Send, and see the message appear in the customer’s chat. • Refresh status and view “sent”, “delivered”, or “read” inside the app. • Restart the program and find the same event logged in SQLite. If you have already worked with the WhatsApp Business or Cloud API in Delphi (or even in another language you can port), please mention it—experience here matters more than general messaging know-how.

We need a hybrid AI Video Operator & Video Editor to produce 1 faceless/documentary-style video per week (3 to 12 minutes). We are starting with a minimum viable budget using AI video generators (e.g., Pictory, FlexClip, Reap, or Mootion), but you must possess the manual editing skills (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve) to assemble higher-end documentary videos as we scale our budget and channel quality. Project Timeline & Engagement Structure: We are structuring this as a short-term trial that converts into an ongoing rolling contract. Phase 1: Paid Trial Period (February 1, 2027 – April 2, 2027): The chosen freelancer will be hired for an initial two-month paid trial run (approx. 9 weeks/videos). This allows us to test the workflow, measure video quality, and assess initial engagement. Phase 2: Month-to-Month Extension: Should the trial videos work well and generate the results we require, we will continue making use of your services on an ongoing basis. This will be strictly month-to-month; we do not want to be locked into any long-term contracts. Scope of Work (Weekly Deliverables)1. Video Production (The 70/20/10 Matrix) You will generate 1 video per week based on our provided content matrix. Topics will range from global tech supply chains (70%), school budgeting insights (20%), to specific STEM equipment demos (10%). Use AI to draft the script following our "Statrys-style" format: 80% broad, engaging industry context, ending with a 20% soft pivot to BMS Education's solutions. Generate a high-quality AI voiceover (using ElevenLabs or a premium AppSumo equivalent—no robotic voices). Stitch together relevant stock footage, AI graphics, and our real product photos. Bonus Deliverable: Cut two 30-60 second vertical Shorts from the main weekly video for YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn. 2. Asset Management & Collaboration Because our asset library is still growing, you will act as the director. You must provide us with a prioritized "Asset Checklist" (e.g., Urgent: Need a video of a student plugging in a robotics board. Later: Need photos of the warehouse). We will film and upload these as you request them. Be patient and creative with stock footage in the meantime. 3. The Pabbly Connect Omni-Channel Publishing Workflow We use Pabbly Connect to automate our approvals and distribute content. You are responsible for configuring this automated distribution pipeline. You must adhere strictly to this timeline: Thursday: Upload the final .mp4 files (1 long-form, 2 vertical Shorts), thumbnails, and a text file containing the Titles, Descriptions, and ActiveCampaign UTM tracking links to our Google Drive draft folder. Friday Afternoon: Our internal team will receive an automated Pabbly email alert to review your video. The Automated Omni-Channel Rollout: Once we move your files into the "Approved" folder, your Pabbly workflow must automatically trigger and publish the content across our entire ecosystem: Main Video (Long-form): Auto-published to YouTube, Facebook Video, LinkedIn, and embedded on Blogger. Vertical Shorts: Auto-published to Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn. What We Will Provide (Client Deliverables) To ensure you can hit the ground running, our team will provide the following on day one: Pabbly Connect Access: A login/workspace invite to our lifetime Pabbly account. OpenAI API Key / Credits: We will provide the API key to cover all ChatGPT script-generation costs. Google Drive Ecosystem: A structured, shared Google Drive for you to upload Thursday drafts and download assets. BMS Product Assets: An initial folder of existing raw photos and videos of our STEM/Robotics kits. The Content Matrix: A document outlining the exact topics and target audience pain points for the videos. Payment & Milestone Structure (The Trial Period) To ensure fair compensation and protect both parties, we will use a structured Milestone Payment system for the Feb 1 – Apr 2 trial: Milestone 1 — Setup & Pilot Video (Week 1 / Early Feb): Deliverable: Setup of the Google Drive folders, configuring/testing the Pabbly notification workflow, and full delivery/approval of Video #1 (main video + 2 vertical Shorts). Release: Released immediately upon our sign-off on Friday afternoon. Milestone 2 — Month 1 Trial Batch (February Videos): Deliverable: Weekly production and Thursday uploads for the remaining videos in February (with respective Shorts). Release: Funded upfront into escrow; released at the end of the 4-week block. Milestone 3 — Month 2 Trial Batch (March - April 2): Deliverable: Weekly production and Thursday uploads for the videos spanning March through the end of the trial on April 2. Release: Funded into escrow and released upon verified completion of the final trial batch. To Apply, Please Provide: Your Portfolio: Links to 2 or 3 faceless or documentary-style YouTube videos you have produced (AI-assisted or fully edited). Your Tool Stack: Tell us what AI voice, scripting, and editing software you plan to use to keep costs low while maintaining quality. Your Price/Quote: Please provide your flat-rate bid per completed video (including the two Shorts) OR your proposed flat rate for the entire 2-month trial period.

opportunities.title: 3D Printable Sock Display Foot -- 2
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a clean, printable 3D model of a human foot that I can use to photograph adult crew and knee-high socks. The pose should be angled slightly upward so the heel lifts just enough to show off the pattern and length of the sock without looking overly posed. I don’t need individual toes or anatomical skin detail; a smooth, simplified silhouette is perfect because it keeps print time low and finishes neatly after light sanding. Scale should match an average adult medium foot—roughly US men’s 9 / women’s 10—or you can provide a parametric setup so I can tweak length and girth before slicing. The model has to stand on its own when 3printed, so be sure to keep the underside flat and balance correct. Deliverables: • Finished model in STL (STEP or 3MF optional) ready for FDM printing • Any native CAD file if you build it parametric • One quick render or viewport screenshot so I can see the angle before printing Let me know if you need shoe-size diagrams or additional measurements.

opportunities.title: Presentador TikTok Fútbol y NBA
opportunities.description: Quiero incorporar a un presentador capaz de llevar directos en TikTok centrados en análisis y debates sobre fútbol y NBA. Necesito a alguien que domine ambos deportes, lance datos y opiniones con soltura y, sobre todo, mantenga un tono energético y divertido que enganche a la audiencia desde el primer minuto. Responsabilidades clave • Planificar cada sesión en torno a la actualidad: resultados, estadísticas, historias de vestuario y comparativas entre ligas y jugadores. • Abrir y moderar el debate en tiempo real con los espectadores, fomentando la participación mediante preguntas, encuestas y retos. • Aprovechar las herramientas nativas de TikTok Live (duetos, filtros, comentarios fijados) para mantener un ritmo dinámico y visualmente atractivo. • Cerrar cada directo con un resumen claro y llamados a la acción que impulsen seguidores y engagement para la cuenta. Lo que valoro en tu propuesta • Experiencia previa presentando o comentando eventos deportivos en streaming, radio o podcast. • Conocimiento demostrable de fútbol europeo y NBA, incluidos jugadores, tácticas y estadísticas actuales. • Ejemplos de directos donde se aprecie tu estilo en pantalla y capacidad para mantener la energía. Si disfrutas conversando de deportes y sabes convertir datos en entretenimiento en vivo, quiero conocer tu experiencia y ver tu mejor clip en acción.

opportunities.title: # Freelance B2B Cold Caller – Appointment Setter (Pay Per Appointment + Commission)
opportunities.description: # Freelance B2B Cold Caller – Appointment Setter (Pay Per Appointment + Commission) **Job Type:** Freelance / Remote **Compensation:** $15–$25 per Qualified Appointment + 10–15% Sales Commission **Target Markets:** United States, United Kingdom & UAE ## Job Description We are looking for a motivated and results-driven **Freelance B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter** to join our team and help us generate sales opportunities for our AI and software solutions. You will be contacting cold B2B leads across the US, UK, and UAE using targeted prospect lists that our team researches and provides. These are not random, untargeted lists. We will provide researched leads with relevant business information and potential buying signals to help you approach prospects more effectively. ## What You'll Be Selling You will be introducing businesses to several B2B offers, including: - AI Solutions & AI Automation Services. - Custom Software Development. - Business Process Automation. - Other B2B Technology Solutions. We will provide the offers, their details, and the necessary information to help you understand what you're pitching. ## What We Provide - Researched and targeted B2B lead lists. - Multiple offers to pitch depending on the prospect. - A professional dialer and calling number. - Call scripts, offer details, and guidance. - A separate sales closer who will handle the sales process after you book the meeting. **You focus on one thing: Calling prospects, generating interest, qualifying potential clients, and booking online meetings.** ## Compensation Structure We offer a performance-based compensation model: **1. Fixed Payment Per Appointment** - $15–$25 for every qualified and successfully booked online meeting. **2. Additional Sales Commission** - 10–15% commission on every deal successfully closed from a lead you generated. This means you earn both a fixed appointment payment and additional commission when your prospect becomes a paying client. There is no requirement for you to close the deals yourself. Our dedicated closer will handle the sales calls and closing process. ## Requirements - Previous experience in B2B cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment setting is preferred. - Good spoken English and communication skills. - Confidence in speaking with business owners, managers, and decision-makers. - Ability to handle objections and generate interest. - Professional attitude and a results-oriented mindset. - Experience targeting US, UK, or UAE markets is a plus. ## How to Apply Please include the following in your proposal: 1. Your previous cold calling or appointment-setting experience. 2. Which markets you have experience calling (US, UK, UAE, etc.). 3. Your English proficiency level. 4. Any previous results or appointment-setting experience. **We're looking for someone interested in a long-term freelance collaboration with strong earning potential based on performance.**

opportunities.title: Strategi Raih 5 Juta/Bulan
opportunities.description: Saya menargetkan pendapatan bersih Rp5 juta dalam waktu satu bulan tetapi belum yakin apakah sudah memiliki saluran pemasaran yang benar-benar aktif. Saya membutuhkan bimbingan menyeluruh—mulai dari audit kondisi saat ini hingga rencana aksi harian—agar tujuan ini tercapai. Ruang lingkup yang saya butuhkan: • Audit singkat: telusuri aset digital, akun media sosial, marketplace, atau channel offline yang mungkin sudah ada, lalu laporkan apa yang efektif dan apa yang kosong. • Rencana pemasaran 30 hari: jadwal konten, ide promosi, dan estimasi biaya/hasil. • Funnel sederhana: panduan cara mengarahkan prospek hingga terjadi penjualan pertama. • Tolok ukur: tetapkan metrik mingguan (traffic, leads, konversi) agar saya bisa memantau kemajuan. Saya terbuka terhadap strategi apa pun—organik, iklan berbayar, kolaborasi, atau pendekatan hybrid—selama realistis untuk dicapai oleh pemula dengan sumber daya terbatas. Sertakan contoh tools yang akan dipakai (mis. Canva, Meta Ads, WhatsApp Business, Google Sheets) dan alasan pemilihannya. Prioritas saya adalah kejelasan langkah, bukan laporan tebal. Kirimkan output dalam bentuk dokumen atau slide ringkas plus checklist harian sehingga saya dapat langsung mengeksekusi tanpa kebingungan.

opportunities.title: B2B Tech Sales Partner Needed
opportunities.description: About Us We are a US-registered technology consulting and software development company helping businesses improve operations through AI, automation and custom technology solutions. Our core services include: - AI Agents and AI Automation - AI Workflow Automation - Custom Software and SaaS Development - CRM and Sales Automation - Business Systems Integration - Microsoft Power Platform and SharePoint solutions We have an established portfolio, client testimonials and experience delivering technology projects to businesses. ## The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced B2B Sales and Business Development professional who can help us acquire new clients in the USA and UK. This is not simply a lead-generation position. We want someone who can identify prospects, initiate conversations, understand business requirements, conduct discovery calls, present our services, follow up and successfully close projects. You will work directly with our company leadership and technical team. ## Responsibilities - Identify and approach potential business clients. - Build relationships with founders, CEOs, COOs and CTOs. - Generate and qualify new business opportunities. - Conduct introductory and discovery calls. - Understand business challenges and recommend suitable technology solutions. - Coordinate with our technical team for proposals and estimates. - Manage follow-ups, negotiations and closing. - Maintain a simple CRM pipeline and weekly activity reports. ## Ideal Candidate - 3+ years of B2B sales or business development experience. - Experience selling IT services, software development, SaaS, AI solutions or technology consulting. - Strong communication and negotiation skills. - Experience selling to businesses in the USA or UK. - Ability to independently source and develop opportunities. - Existing professional network is an advantage. - Comfortable managing the complete sales cycle. ## Compensation We propose the following starting structure: - Monthly retainer: - Performance commission: **X% of eligible project service revenue collected from new clients successfully sourced and closed by you.** - Initial engagement: 30-day trial. - Potential for a longer-term partnership based on results. The retainer covers agreed part-time business development activities, prospecting, follow-ups and reporting. Commission rewards successful client acquisition and closed business. The exact weekly hours, activity expectations, attribution rules and payment schedule will be agreed before starting. All payments and performance bonuses will be handled through the relevant platform contract and its payment rules. ## What We Provide - Company profile, portfolio and case studies. - Service descriptions and marketing materials. - Technical support for discovery calls and solution discussions. - Proposal preparation and project estimation support. - Delivery team to execute successfully closed projects. ## How to Apply Please include: 1. Your experience selling IT services, software development, AI or SaaS. 2. Examples of deals you have personally closed. 3. Your experience targeting USA and UK businesses. 4. How you normally source prospects and generate opportunities. 5. Your availability and expectations regarding the monthly retainer. 6. Whether you can independently manage the complete sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. We are looking for a results-oriented sales partner interested in building a long-term relationship with a growing technology company.

opportunities.title: B2B Business Development & GTM Consultant for AI powered SaaS Product (Pilot for India region)
opportunities.description: We are a technology startup building an AI-powered customer interaction platform that automates business conversations over voice calls and WhatsApp (Conversational bot - text and voice). This post is for paid pilot assignment over approximately two-three weeks. Where we would like you to demonstrates good market understanding and produce some actionable results. Then we can move to monthly engagement. We are looking for an experienced freelance Business Development Consultant who can help us identify potential customers, develop practical sales strategies and build an initial customer acquisition pipeline in India. What we are looking for - Identify promising industries and business segments for our AI voice and WhatsApp automation platform. - Define target customer profiles and identify relevant decision-makers. - Research potential companies and build a qualified prospect database. - Develop practical B2B outreach strategies using LinkedIn, email, calls, social media and partnerships. - Prepare outreach messages, follow-up sequences and introductory sales pitches. - Help initiate conversations with prospects and generate qualified product demo opportunities. - Review market feedback and suggest improvements to our positioning and sales approach. We can quantify initial short pilot after discussion with candidate. Indicative deliverables like below - - Understand product, its capabilities and use cases (We will help you). - Recommend 2–3 target industry segments and buyer personas. - Prepare a list of 40–50 researched target companies and decision-makers. - Develop LinkedIn/email outreach messages and a follow-up strategy. - Present a 30-day customer acquisition plan and initial outreach results, Ideal candidate - 4–8 years of experience in B2B business development, good to have SaaS sales or technology consulting. - Good to have experience working with startups or selling software/technology solutions. - Good understanding of B2B sales cycles and decision-makers. - Experience in lead generation, LinkedIn outreach and business partnerships. - Strong research, communication and strategic thinking skills. Engagement - Initial project-based engagement for pilot phase, with potential for ongoing collaboration. - We will provide product demonstrations, product documentation and business context. To apply Please share: 1. Your relevant B2B SaaS / technology business development experience. 2. Few examples of GTM strategies or customer acquisition initiatives you have worked on. 3. Industries and customer segments you have experience selling into. 4. How you would approach acquiring the first 5–10 customers for an AI voice and WhatsApp automation product in India. 5. Your expected hourly or monthly engagement charges after pilot. We are looking for someone who can think strategically as well as execute — not just generate generic contact lists.

opportunities.title: Excel/Sheets Automation Streamlining
opportunities.description: I have several inter-linked workbooks and online data feeds that I touch every day just to move numbers around. My goal is to turn those repetitive copy-paste moments into a single click (or, better yet, a scheduled trigger). Here is what needs to happen: • Incoming data arrives from two places—other Excel / Google Sheets files on my drive and web-based sources such as forms, emails, or a small business system’s export. This data must be imported, cleaned, and combined automatically. • Once the raw data is refreshed, the file should generate polished reports, invoices, and concise summaries without manual intervention. I’m comfortable if you achieve this with VBA macros, Google Apps Script, Power Query, or any mix that suits the environment; the key is reliability and minimal maintenance on my side. Clear, well-commented code or scripts and a short hand-off guide are mandatory so I can tweak small items later. Deliverables considered complete when: 1. A single action (button or timed trigger) fetches and cleans the latest data from every listed source. 2. Reports and invoices populate in their designated tabs or PDFs with correct formulas, formatting, and date stamps. 3. No errors appear when the solution is run on both Windows Excel and Google Sheets versions of the file, or a justified explanation is given if platform-specific features are required. If this sounds like a straightforward challenge for you, let’s automate my workflow and reclaim those hours.

opportunities.title: Migración Completa A3CON a A3RP
opportunities.description: Quiero trasladar absolutamente toda la información que hoy tengo en A3CON — datos contables, históricos, documentos adjuntos, clientes y proveedores — a A3RP sin perder ni un detalle. Una vez importados los datos necesito que A3RP quede listo para trabajar con la misma estructura que utilizamos ahora: contabilidad al día, impuestos configurados y los modelos preparados para su presentación. Además de la migración y la configuración, requiero una breve sesión de explicación para mi equipo. La idea es que, al finalizar, cada usuario entienda dónde está cada cosa y pueda seguir con su operativa diaria sin interrupciones. Entrego acceso a ambos entornos y estaré disponible para resolver cualquier duda sobre nuestros flujos actuales o sobre la nomenclatura interna que manejamos. Espero una validación final conjunta para verificar que los saldos, los informes y los modelos coincidan con los datos originales antes de dar por cerrado el proyecto.

opportunities.title: AI Video Demonstrating Product Solution
opportunities.description: I need an AI-generated video that clearly shows how my physical product solves a common, real-world problem. The goal is to let viewers grasp the pain point, watch the item in action, and immediately understand why it works better than anything they have tried before. You will receive photos, short clips, and a brief outline of the problem/solution scenario. From there, create a concise script, generate any supplementary visuals with your preferred AI tools (Runway, Synthesia, Pika, Midjourney, or similar), add a natural-sounding voice-over, and deliver a final cut that is ready to publish on social channels and my website. Key deliverables: • 60–90 second HD video (16:9) • Script, voice-over, AI visuals, basic motion graphics, light music bed • Two revision rounds to fine-tune messaging, pacing, or on-screen text Acceptance criteria: 1. The problem is introduced within the first 5 seconds. 2. The product is shown actively fixing that problem, not just displayed statically. 3. Final export is clean of watermarks and suitable for YouTube & Instagram. I’ll supply prompt feedback and any product details you need so we can move quickly from concept to final render.

opportunities.title: ServiceNow Workflow & API Automation
opportunities.description: I need to streamline our ServiceNow instance so that approvals, tickets, and requests run hands-free. The first milestone is a self-service password-delivery flow: once a user’s request meets our policy rules, ServiceNow should generate a secure password and send it to the requester automatically—no manual steps, no lag. To build this you’ll draw on IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, JavaScript, and REST/SOAP APIs, wiring ServiceNow to any downstream system the flow requires. Clean scripting, clear documentation, and upgrade-safe update sets are non-negotiable. Deliverables • A scoped app or flow that detects an eligible request, runs the necessary approval logic, creates the password, and communicates it to the user. • All integrations configured and tested in our sub-prod instance. • A concise runbook and update sets ready for production deployment. Acceptance criteria: a test user receives the correct password within our agreed SLA and the audit trail shows each automated step. If you have deep ServiceNow automation and integration experience, I’m ready to review your plan and timeline.

opportunities.title: Auditoría de Seguridad React Native y Supabase
opportunities.description: # Auditoría inicial de seguridad de aplicación móvil (React Native + Supabase) Estamos buscando un profesional o empresa especializada en ciberseguridad para realizar una primera revisión técnica de una aplicación móvil actualmente en fase de desarrollo. **Tecnologías utilizadas:** - React Native. - Supabase (PostgreSQL, autenticación, almacenamiento y Edge Functions). - GitHub. - Codex. ### Objetivo del trabajo Realizar una auditoría inicial de seguridad que permita identificar posibles vulnerabilidades, errores de configuración y riesgos técnicos antes de incorporar nuevas integraciones y avanzar hacia el lanzamiento. ### Alcance de la revisión - Análisis del código fuente y arquitectura de la aplicación. - Revisión de seguridad de React Native. - Auditoría de Supabase y políticas de seguridad RLS. - Revisión de autenticación, sesiones y gestión de permisos. - Comprobación de accesos entre diferentes cuentas de usuario. - Revisión de APIs, Edge Functions y almacenamiento. - Detección de credenciales, claves y secretos expuestos. - Revisión de dependencias y posibles vulnerabilidades conocidas. - Evaluación de la seguridad de las comunicaciones y almacenamiento local. ### Entregables esperados 1. Informe técnico de auditoría. 2. Identificación y clasificación de vulnerabilidades según su nivel de gravedad. 3. Recomendaciones concretas para resolver los problemas detectados. 4. Priorización de las correcciones. 5. Reunión con el desarrollador para explicar los resultados y resolver dudas. 6. Posibilidad de realizar una segunda comprobación una vez aplicadas las correcciones. ### Perfil que buscamos - Experiencia demostrable en auditorías de aplicaciones móviles. - Conocimientos sólidos de React Native. - Experiencia en Supabase, PostgreSQL y políticas RLS. - Experiencia en seguridad de APIs y backend. - Conocimientos de OWASP MASVS y OWASP API Security. - Capacidad para realizar pruebas manuales de seguridad, además de análisis automatizados. ### Información para presentar candidatura Solicitamos que las propuestas incluyan: - Experiencia y referencias en trabajos similares. - Metodología de auditoría. - Alcance exacto de los servicios incluidos. - Plazo estimado de ejecución. - Presupuesto desglosado. - Confirmación de que se puede firmar un acuerdo de confidencialidad (NDA) antes de facilitar cualquier acceso o información técnica. **Importante:** Por motivos de confidencialidad, los detalles funcionales y comerciales del proyecto se facilitarán únicamente al profesional seleccionado, una vez firmado el correspondiente acuerdo de confidencialidad. Buscamos una colaboración profesional, rigurosa y con posibilidad de continuidad en posteriores fases del proyecto.

opportunities.title: Asistente Virtual Agenda y Redes
opportunities.description: Necesito apoyo estable para que mi calendario esté siempre al día y mis perfiles sociales mantengan una presencia constante sin que pierda el control de lo que se publica. Trabajo con Google Calendar y Gmail para la parte de agenda, y utilizo WhatsApp, Instagram y Facebook para comunicarme y difundir contenido. Lo que espero de tu parte: • Organización de agenda, citas y reuniones – Registrar y actualizar eventos en Google Calendar. – Enviar recordatorios y avisos oportunos por correo o WhatsApp. – Proponer ajustes cuando surjan conflictos de horario. • Redes sociales y creación de contenido – Elaborar borradores de publicaciones (texto, imágenes o ideas de reel) alineados con mi tono. – Presentar el calendario de publicaciones semanal para mi aprobación. – Programar el contenido aprobado y, si es necesario, responder mensajes básicos señalando los que requieran mi respuesta personal. Nivel de acceso: tendrás acceso limitado; nada se publica ni se envía sin mi visto bueno. Prefiero revisar todo antes de que salga en redes o correos. Busco a alguien organizado, creativo y con buena comunicación en español. Si tienes experiencia previa usando las mismas herramientas será un plus. Indícame brevemente tu método de trabajo y algún ejemplo de cuentas o calendarios que hayas gestionado. Espero tu propuesta para empezar cuanto antes y aliviar mi carga diaria.

opportunities.title: AI-Enabled Restaurant POS
opportunities.description: Ya he desarrollado varias tiendas en línea y otros sistemas, y ahora necesito llevar la experiencia al salón: un punto de venta para restaurante/cafetería totalmente integrado con un módulo de inteligencia artificial que potencie su operación. El software debe correr en equipos estándar de caja y permitir: • Cobros rápidos, emisión de tickets y cierre de caja al final del turno. • Gestión de inventario con alertas automáticas cuando las existencias bajen del umbral definido. • Registro de clientes, ventas en línea sincronizadas y un esquema sencillo para aplicar promociones. Entrego la lógica de negocio y los flujos básicos; tú te encargas de la arquitectura, la interfaz y la conexión con la IA (API o motor que sugieras). Aprecio un código limpio, bien documentado y un instalador listo para pruebas en un entorno Windows o web-based, según convengamos. Cuando finalicemos, necesito: 1. Código fuente completo y manual de instalación. 2. Script o procedimiento de respaldo y restauración de la base de datos. 3. Video corto (o sesión en vivo) mostrando el flujo de venta, el cierre de caja y una alerta de inventario en acción. Si ya has creado POS para gastronomía o integraciones de IA, menciona los detalles: facilita la comparación y acelera la puesta en marcha.

opportunities.title: Diseño y Unificación de Plataforma Tecnológica para Inmobiliaria Líder
opportunities.description: Una reconocida inmobiliaria de CABA busca profesionales del diseño para liderar la transformación y centralización de sus desarrollos tecnológicos. El objetivo principal es unificar la experiencia de usuario y la identidad visual de un nuevo producto en desarrollo, junto con la revisión y estandarización de dos productos existentes, para ofrecer una propuesta coherente y eficiente a nuestros asesores inmobiliarios. Este proyecto se estima en un año y se ejecutará en las siguientes etapas clave: 1. Diseño y desarrollo de un Multiposteador en portales inmobiliarios: Esta fase, con una duración estimada de 3 a 5 meses, implica la creación de una herramienta que permita a los asesores publicar propiedades de manera centralizada en diversos portales. Se requiere un diseño intuitivo y funcional. 2. Migración del CRM actual al nuevo portal: Durante 2 a 3 meses, se trabajará en la integración y migración de nuestro sistema CRM existente al nuevo portal, asegurando una transición fluida y una experiencia de usuario mejorada. El diseño debe facilitar la gestión de clientes y propiedades. 3. Integración con sistema de atención de consultas automatizado por IA: En un plazo de 2 meses, se realizará la integración visual y funcional con un sistema de inteligencia artificial para la atención automatizada de consultas, garantizando una interfaz amigable y eficiente para los usuarios. Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Diseño Web ¿Qué necesitas?: Crear un nuevo diseño personalizado
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante: F. F. (Argentina). Publicó el anuncio en Workana (Hace 22 horas) con presupuesto de USD 1.000 - 3.000.

opportunities.title: Comercial a comisión para vender devoluciones de Amazon a tiendas y mayoristas (España)
opportunities.description: Somos Reusalia, una empresa de Valencia que vende devoluciones de Amazon a profesionales: cajas, palés y camiones completos. Cada lote lleva su listado artículo a artículo, con el valor de cada cosa en Amazon. Hay hogar, menaje, niños, motor, bricolaje y electrónica. Buscamos un comercial que consiga clientes NUEVOS en España: bazares, tiendas de segunda mano, puestos de mercadillo, tiendas online, mayoristas y compradores de stock. CÓMO COBRAS - Solo comisión, sin sueldo fijo. - Cobras por lo que compran los clientes que consigas, también por lo que repitan. - Se cobra una vez al mes, por lo que tus clientes ya han pagado. - Las condiciones exactas las hablamos contigo. QUÉ TE DAMOS - Contactos para empezar: tiendas que encajan y personas que ya se han interesado por nuestros lotes. - Teléfono con WhatsApp Business y correo de la empresa. - Un enlace personal: las ventas que salen de él se te apuntan solas. - El catálogo siempre al día, con fotos y listados. QUÉ BUSCAMOS - Experiencia vendiendo a tiendas o mayoristas. Mejor si conoces los saldos, el stock, el bazar o la ferretería. - Español nativo o perfecto, y soltura al teléfono y por WhatsApp. - Que trabajes como autónomo y organices tu tiempo. No hay horario. - Que trabajes contacto a contacto. Nada de envíos masivos. PARA PRESENTARTE Empieza tu propuesta con la palabra STOCK y contesta en pocas líneas: 1. Qué has vendido antes, a quién y cuánto al mes. 2. A qué tiendas o compradores llegas hoy (zona y sector). 3. Cómo conseguirías tus 5 primeros clientes.

📲 Nuestro WhatsApp directo es **+57 322 273 9034**. ¿A qué dirección o laboratorio les enviamos muestra física y ficha técnica de nuestro Borbón Rosado?
